messages:
anna_sales: FYI Acme Healthcare needs SOC2 snapshot + signed pen-test letter for the POC. They also want a 48‑hr staging IP window and an estimate of any additional fees if we move to a Dedicated pool for the trial. Target delivery by next Tue.
mike_se: got it. Can we clarify scope: full SOC2 report or redacted SOC2 / control matrix excerpt?
anna_sales: they said 'security artifacts' — prefer redacted SOC2 + ISO excerpt if available. pen-test letter must be signed by someone authorized.
zach_security: for pen-test letter we have a template. It states scope: external vuln scan + creds if requested, and we can sign as "Redwood Security Team". But legal needs to OK who signs.
lisa_legal: I can sign but need to confirm canonical signer name + entity. Also confirm non-disclosure on uploaded artifacts.
raj_acme: quick note from Acme — redacted SOC2 + pen-test letter is fine. We can accept a limited-scope attestation. We will need presigned upload links for the dataroom.
lara_ops: staging IP window: we usually open a /27 ephemeral range for scans. Who will own the permit and scheduling? Also need to know if the POC runs on Dedicated GPUs (affects firewall rules).
anna_sales: @lara_ops they'll be on our staging cluster (hosted) by default, but may request Dedicated for throughput testing. Need cost delta for Dedicated during POC.
peter_finance: rough ballpark: Dedicated reserved nightly burst for a 2-week POC ~ $6k–$10k depending on GPU class. Hosted incremental usage likely < $1k for light usage. I'll send a formal quote if we confirm duration and instance class.
mike_se: action items I suggest: (1) security to upload pen-test template and SOC2 redacted excerpt, (2) legal to confirm signatory, (3) ops to pre-authorize staging IP window and provide presigned S3 upload, (4) finance to send POC cost delta. Anyone object?
zach_security: uploading now. I'll drop a zip to s3://redwood-attestations/acme-poc/ with README. Pen-test-letter-template.pdf attached. Note: external scan schedule needs 48‑72h lead.
lisa_legal: signature: I can sign as "Lisa Bryant, Head of Legal, Redwood Inference, Inc.". Confirmed no additional NDAs required beyond existing MSA. I'll prepare the signed PDF once security confirms final wording.
lara_ops: pre-authorized CIDR: 34.120.160.0/27 reserved for Wed-Fri next week. Presigned upload link will be posted to this thread in ~15m.
deploy-bot: Audit log: presigned links created by lara_ops at 1754123560
anna_sales: Raj, does Wed-Fri window work for your scans?
raj_acme: yes Wed-Fri works. We'll run external scans Thu morning. Thanks.
mike_se: @peter_finance ping for the quote to confirm Dedicated uplift.
peter_finance: sending a quick quote: Dedicated two-week trial (A100 equiv) = $9,200. Hosted estimate = $750 (token + short-run compute). I'll email line-item quote and CC sales.
mike_se: perfect. Once Lisa signs pen-test letter and Zach uploads redacted SOC2 we can hand off to Acme and schedule the scan.
zach_security: uploaded:
- s3://redwood-attestations/acme-poc/soc2-redacted-2025-03.pdf
- s3://redwood-attestations/acme-poc/pen-test-letter-template-sample.pdf
Link is presigned for 7 days.
lisa_legal: signing now. ETA 2 business hours.
anna_sales: great — please post final signed letter and I'll hand to Acme. Also I'll include the Dedicated quote in the POC agreement.
raj_acme: received the links. We'll confirm once scan completes. Appreciate the quick turnaround!
anna_sales: thanks everyone :thumbsup: We should be able to meet Tue delivery if signing finishes today. Closing the loop after upload.
